title: Hires Per Calendar Quarter
description:
Report how many employees were hired in each calendar quarter (`Q1` = Jan-Mar, `Q2` = Apr-Jun, `Q3` = Jul-Sep, `Q4` = Oct-Dec), across all years combined.

Name the columns `quarter` and `hires`. Return the result in any order.
solutionSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', hire_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', hire_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', hire_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3'
    ELSE 'Q4'
  END AS quarter,
  COUNT(*) AS hires
FROM employees
GROUP BY quarter;
hint: strftime('%m', ...) returns the month as zero-padded text ('04') — CAST it to INTEGER before comparing with BETWEEN, or the comparison happens on the wrong type.
outputExplanation: Four employees were hired in Q1 (January-March), one in Q2, two in Q3 and one in Q4.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);
